functions.name: cancel-orderline
functions.description: Cancel a paid orderline; Back Market states that cancellation refunds the customer for that orderline.

sku.description: Seller SKU matching one orderline within the order.

orderId.description: Order containing the target paid orderline.

functions.name: create-buyback-counteroffer
functions.description: Submit a counteroffer on an owned BuyBack order with an exact price, eligible reason IDs, optional explanation and supporting files. Requires the owning refurbisher.

mediaType.description: Media type of the supporting file.

contentBase64.description: Standard base64 of exact file bytes; implementation decodes it for upload.

items.description: A supporting file with its original filename, media type and exact bytes.

files.description: Supporting JPEG, PNG or PDF bytes; an empty array explicitly supplies no files if the provider permits this.

amount.description: Exact nonnegative counteroffer amount in the order currency's major units; currency is fixed by the order, not selected here. Unit mapping is provisional.

comment.description: Explanation up to 200 characters; omission sends no comment, null retains the provider's explicit null choice, and empty text remains empty.

items.description: An eligible counteroffer reason identifier for this order.

reasonIds.description: Eligible reason IDs from list-buyback-counteroffer-reasons for this order.

buybackOrderId.description: Public ID of the BuyBack order owned by the connected refurbisher.

FunctionInput_back_market_createbuybackc.description: Submit an exact counteroffer amount, eligible reasons and optional supporting evidence for an owned BuyBack order.

accepted.description: Provider accepted submission; does not establish customer acceptance, payment or a returned counteroffer identity.

buybackOrderId.description: Order public ID targeted by the accepted request.

FunctionOutput_back_market_createbuyback.description: Acknowledgement that Back Market accepted the counteroffer submission for the targeted order.

tags.instructions: Get buybackOrderId and offer currency from `get-buyback-order`, and current eligible reason IDs from `list-buyback-counteroffer-reasons`. This submits a price proposal to the order workflow; it is not just a message or listing-price change. Supporting files may be JPEG, PNG or PDF. A successful result means the provider accepted the request, not that the customer accepted the offer. Inspect the order before retrying an uncertain write.

This declares an existing outbound shipment; it does not buy a label or prove delivery. Check the folder before retrying an uncertain registration.

functions.description: Declare an after-sales problem on a supported care folder, including required evidence files.

text.description: Optional ordinary Unicode explanation; omission sends no explanation.

attachments.description: Evidence files, at most 3 MB each; at least one required for DAMAGED_PACKAGE, ITEM_NOT_RECEIVED and OOW_ITEM.

content.description: Original evidence bytes using the environment's binary representation.

items.description: An evidence file with its original bytes and filename.

problemType.description: Problem classification. OTHER is accepted only before December 1, 2026; choose a specific type whenever possible.

FunctionInput_back_market_createcarefold.description: Declare a problem on a supported care folder, with any required evidence.

declared.description: Provider accepted the declaration; not a guarantee of resolution.

FunctionOutput_back_market_createcarefol.description: Acknowledgment that Back Market accepted the care folder problem declaration.

Damaged-package, item-not-received and out-of-warranty-item declarations need evidence. Attach at most 10 files, each at most 3 MB. Check the folder before retrying an uncertain declaration.

functions.name: create-orderline-lifecycle-refund
functions.description: Refund an accepted or shipped orderline in full through its lifecycle transition, optionally recording a reason and a customer message for post-shipping refunds.

sku.description: Seller SKU identifying the target orderline.

text.description: Optional customer-facing refund message, applicable only for shipped stage; Unicode text unchanged.

stage.description: Current stage, selecting refunded-before-shipping or refunded-after-shipping.

returnReason.description: Optional refund reason; omission sends none.

FunctionInput_back_market_createorderlin.description: Target orderline and lifecycle refund details.

state.description: Refund state confirmed in provider response; not settlement timing.

FunctionOutput_back_market_createorderli.description: Orderline refund lifecycle state confirmed by Back Market.

tags.instructions: Read `get-order` for the order ID, target SKU and current state. This moves accepted lines to refunded-before-shipping or shipped lines to refunded-after-shipping. Use `create-orderline-refund` instead for a specified partial amount or a paid-line refund. Customer messages apply only after shipping. Refund reversal is not documented; do not blindly retry.

functions.name: create-orderline-refund
functions.description: Create a full refund for a paid or accepted orderline, or a specified partial/full amount for a shipped orderline.

amount.description: Refund amount in the orderline's currency major units, required only for shipped; exact decimal text, never cents.

FunctionInput_back_market_createorderlin.description: Orderline and current refund stage, with an explicit amount only for shipped orderlines.

summary.description: Provider's human-readable refund confirmation, not parsed into invented financial fields.

FunctionOutput_back_market_createorderli.description: Provider confirmation of the refund request, without any settlement timing guarantee.

tags.instructions: Use `get-order` to obtain the orderline ID, currency and current state. Select the refund stage matching paid, accepted or shipped. Shipped refunds require an explicit amount. This issues a financial refund; reversibility is not documented. Never blindly retry an uncertain refund.

Unspecified markets are preserved by the tool. Zero is an offline action, not a free offer. Use `disable-buyback-listing` to take selected existing markets offline without supplying prices. Check the listing before retrying after an uncertain write.

No resume action or guaranteed reversibility is exposed here. Inspect `get-buyback-order` after an uncertain result before retrying.

functions.name: update-care-folder-note
functions.description: Create or replace the complete note on a care folder, or clear it with null.

note.description: Complete replacement note, up to 2000 characters. Null clears it; empty text is sent as empty text, not silently changed to null.

careFolderId.description: Care folder identifier of at least 100000000.

note.description: Saved note as returned by the provider; null means cleared.

tags.instructions: Get a supported folder ID from `list-care-folders`. This replaces the entire note rather than appending text. Pass null to clear the note. Only folder IDs at least 100000000 support notes. Use `reply-care-folder` for a conversation message instead.

functions.name: update-listing
functions.description: Immediately modify selected listing stock, price, comment, warranty and shipping-option fields without replacing omitted fields.

market.description: Market locale; omitted uses provider default.

price.description: Exact decimal price in currency major units.

comment.description: Replacement comment; null requests clearing, empty string is sent unchanged.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency matching market; required when changing price.

minPrice.description: BackPricer minimum decimal price; null requests clearing. Provider may reset invalid bounds to current price.

quantity.description: Available stock; zero takes the listing offline.

shippingChanges.description: Changes to up to three shipping slots; slot numbers must be distinct.

price.description: Decimal shipping price in listing currency; null requests clearing.

delayHours.description: Shipping delay in hours; null requests clearing.

displayName.description: Displayed carrier name; null requests clearing.

shipperName.description: Provider carrier name, such as DHL; null requests clearing this field.

items.description: Partial modifications to one shipping slot.

changes.description: Partial listing modifications; omitted fields remain unchanged.

listingId.description: Listing UUID preferred; legacy ID also accepted.

FunctionInput_back_market_updatelisting.description: Immediately update selected fields of one listing in the selected market.

price.description: Resulting decimal price in currency major units.

minPrice.description: Actual accepted minimum price, including provider adjustment.

price.description: Decimal shipping amount in listing currency.

market.description: Market locale.

items.description: A saved listing-level shipping option.

shippingMessages.description: Provider shipping success/failure messages; not fabricated per-slot success flags.

items.description: A provider shipping processing message.

FunctionOutput_back_market_updatelisting.description: Actual saved listing values and provider shipping processing messages.

tags.instructions: Get the listing ID with `get-listing` or `list-listings`. Use this for immediate changes; quantity 0 takes the listing offline. Price changes need a matching market currency. Shipping changes target slots 1–3 and can partially fail: inspect shippingMessages. Use `batch-upsert-listings` for asynchronous multiple-target ingestion.

shippedAt.description: Optional shipment instant with explicit offset, normalized without precision loss; omitted uses provider behavior.

serialNumber.description: Optional serial number for a single-unit single-line order; cannot later be corrected.
